SUBMISSION PDF

New York Times crossword

Creates a numbered answer grid, a blank grid, and double-spaced Across/Down clues with answers in a right-hand column. Contact details are included only in the PDF and are not saved with your puzzle.

Formatting follows the current NYT technical checklist, but does not guarantee acceptance. Review the latest submission guidelines before sending.
